children: A newly created wallet suspected of belonging to a hacker received 3,100 ETH from Tornado Cash, sold it for about $6.92 million in USDC, and deposited the funds into Hyperliquid. According to Odaily, citing Lookonchain, the wallet then opened a 20x leveraged long position of 169.47 BTC, with a notional value of about $12.84 million, and a 20x leveraged short position of 5,740 ETH, worth about $12.83 million.

title: Suspected Hacker Opens 20x BTC Long and ETH Short on Hyperliquid, Each Exceeding $12.8 Million
